data.title: Hi Sun Technology Eyes Exit From Cloopen Stake via Premium-Priced Merger
data.description:
An announcement from Hi Sun Technology (China) Limited ( (HK:0818) ) is now available.

Hi Sun Technology (China) Limited has announced a possible disposal of its 17.18% stake in Cloopen via a planned merger that would take Cloopen private and make it a wholly owned subsidiary of HoldCo. Main Access, Hi Sun’s indirect wholly owned unit, has submitted a proxy voting in favour of all resolutions at Cloopen’s extraordinary general meeting on September 24, 2026, but may still attend and vote in person.
